glosses: forest; bush; jungle; woods (uncultivated area covered in wild plants)
wild grass, weeds and other low-lying plants

examples.en: Could you survive alone in the wilderness?

examples.text: Tom morreu só numa cabana no mato.
examples.en: Tom died alone in a small cabin in the woods.

examples.text: Meu cachorro às vezes come mato.
Se fizer mal a ela, eu mato você.
examples.en: If you harm her in any way, I'll kill you.

examples.text: Esta é a primeira vez que eu mato um rato.
examples.en: This is the first time I've killed a mouse.
